notes.title: DashPanel 1.9.1
notes.content:
Update 1.9.1
IMPORTANT: DashPanel is now using a new networking library.

If your server updates and your client has not yet updated you will not be able to connect.
Make sure to update both Client and Server to ensure connection is possible.

It can take longer for mobile stores to update, if you need to use the previous version until your client updates change the Steam version of DashPanel to the 1.8.17_legacynetworking branch.

Note: In case of issues even after updating selecting "Use Legacy networking" on BOTH client and server will use the old networking.

New:
-Changed networking library to LiteNetLib fixing many connection issues
-Support Farming Simulator 22
-Heading widget (ACC, AC, TruckSims, FS)
-Tyre pressure precision option now up to 3
-Fuel Delta
-Fuel and Fuel Laps Alert trigger

Fix: 
-Intervals not working correctly in some circumstances
-TouchPad wasn't saving settings

AMS2:
-Fix Flag for double waved and FCY
-Pit limiter in practice session
Forza:
-Fix fuel calculator
-UDP data glitching
ETS/ATS:
-Prevent fuel needle showing past capacity with external tanks. SDK does not report external tank fuel.
pCars 2:
-Add Push to pass
pCars 2 UDP:
-Add Brake bias
-Boost
BeamNG:
-Fix engine temperature

Server:
-Launch on startup option was no longer working
-Fix blurriness at different scales
-Game tab is now focused only on configuration files, previous layout gave users the false impression if an install wasn't located it wouldn't be detected when running.
-Fix button box keys that required extended scan code (LeftControl, RightControl, LeftAlt, RightAlt, LeftWindowsKey, RightWindowsKey, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, UpArrow, DownArrow, LeftArrow, RightArrow, NumberPadSlash, NumberPadEnter)

Steam PC Client only:
-Improve method to ensure client is visible on a monitor.
-Ensure only local clients switch to overlay mode

notes.title: Virtual Button Box DLC
notes.content:
DashPanel now supports Windows Touch Screens.

Use virtual buttons to trigger keystrokes on your PC via attached touch screens.
This can be a single key combination with up to three modifier keys or a recorded macro with any number of keystrokes.

Note that owning a full data DLC will already give you unlimited button presses for games supported by that DLC. This product is for use with any desktop application that has focus.
